protocol.selection: Architecture: smallest history-minus-control validation log loss. Then vary windows/format/epochs on that architecture. Repeat the best real-history pair on seeds 43/44; swapped is a control only.
protocol.scope: Adaptive development comparisons on inspected validation; no final-test claim

seed_selection.scope: Selected on inspected validation; repeats are not independent final testing

caution: Adaptive development sweeps, one inspected session split; no final-test estimate.

training_seed_repeats.scope: Three training seeds, fixed inspected validation; selected on seed 42. No final-test estimate.

secondary_epoch_replication.scope: Secondary replication after observing a 1.5625 percentage-point accuracy gain with essentially unchanged log loss at three epochs. This is separate from the predeclared minimum-log-loss selection and does not change the original 18-fit plan.

secondary_plan.rationale: Secondary replication after observing a 1.5625 percentage-point accuracy gain with essentially unchanged log loss at three epochs. This is separate from the predeclared minimum-log-loss selection and does not change the original 18-fit plan.
secondary_plan.resource_retry: GPU 0 was filled by another workload before training; reroute seed 43 to GPU 2 after the primary sweep. Training settings and samples are unchanged.

resource_retry: GPU 0 became full before seed-43 training; same configuration rerun on GPU 2 after the primary sweep.

assignment_control_comparison.scope: Preserves causal profile set; tests seat assignment, not removal of all historical information.
